reviews.text: Jorg the vet is very professional, knowledgeable and explains everything comprehensively, no stone left unturned, and without any unnecessary expensive add ons. I left feeling very reassured, and that my much loved cleft lip cocker spaniel had been in great hands . Thank you Jorg 👍🙂 …
I was very worried as Maisie is very nervous but the vet was very kind to him and he didn't seem too stressed.  She reassured me about his teeth and he hasn't even run away from me this morning!
Attended for our pup’s second vaccinations and health check. The vet was brilliant! Everything was fully explained, with all options explored - we left feeling that we were in good hands.

If your pet needs steroids this is the place to go! All they seem capable of offering. So glad I switched to a new vets who diagnosed and actioned my dogs problem in one visit. Waste of time and money . Complaint has been made 6 weeks ago and keep getting fobbed off
Fantastic every time so caring to tiger he is a nervous cat thank you so much

After having a terrible experience at another vet, I've been going to Yorkshire Vets in Horsforth for a few years now.  I've always found the staff very friendly, extremely informative and they show care and compassion.

Like most pets, my cat is not a good patient. She is extremely shy and wary under normal circumstances. A trip to see the vet is stressful for her. However whenever we have visited, the care  she has received has been very good indeed. All the staff are helpful, friendly and professional. They accommodate my cat's odd behaviour with gentleness and kindness. It is easy to make an appointment, prices are clearly explained and I am very happy with the service we  have received.

I would avoid this not local but massive corporate owned vets. A third party company contacted me to book my pets in but had incorrect information. They pretend to be from Yorkshire Vets but are actually from a third party company that Yorkshire Vets outsource calling you. I have asked them to not share my details with any third part company and the receptionist couldn't do so. Appears to be breaching GDPR, and if they are able to break this law, what else do they do?
I asked for the practice manager to call me, and they said they couldn't unless I emailed.
I asked when the practice manager comes to branch "never" they advised.
How can a practice manager, manage a branch and checks it's running to a high standard if they never attend branch.
I have registered with another vets and reporting to the ICO for breaching GDPR
I feel welcome at the practice and confident in the care and advice I receive for my pet. Thoroughly recommend this practice
Very lovely people with so much positive energy and you can feel love! Vey knowledgeable and helpful. Nonjudgmental just willing to help. Thank you!

Visited the surgery today with Chip (one of my cleft lip spaniels) with a hook claw that had cut into, and ulcerated a pad in his paw. Chip is the strongest little dog I have ever known, and has been banned from all the local groomers as he barrel rolls and fights whenever ANYONE goes near his paws. I wish I’d remembered their names (to thank them properly) as the two girls really went the extra mile, and were amazing in quickly and efficiently clipping all the nails on all 4 paws, while Chip fought to the best of his ability! Chip is the happiest little dog, and one of the girls remembered me bringing him (and his cleft lip half brother Fluke) when he was only a day or two old. Cleft lip pups can’t suckle, so have to be hand reared, and there are vets out there who out and out refuse to have anything to do with cleft lip pups, but these guys were so helpful and supportive and Chip and Fluke enjoy getting out to The Lake District, Cornwall, and anywhere our Motorhome will take us! To think that the breeders advised to euthanise them both !
Well done guys, Top marks!!!
Able to get an appointment quickly, lovely staff and vet was very thorough.

Staff love their work and everyone, no matter how many accidents there maybe, are all welcomed. They show patience, care and empathy to both animals and their owners. Caring practise who look out for their clients.
The vets were very welcoming. Very happy to explain when I don’t understand things. knowledgeable. 100% Recommend them.
The service at Horsforth vets is always exceptional. It’s clear that their highly skilled and personable team are true animal lovers. We continue to go here even after moving from the area.
